start.greeting:
Hi, this is {{appName}}.

Send me a document, photo, video, or audio file
and I will instantly create a share code for you.
start.menu:
Main commands:
📤 Send a file = create a share code
🔎 Send a code = retrieve a file
📁 /my_files = list your files
🤖 /add_bot = add a personal bot
📚 /help = show how to use it
start.deeplink_received: 📥 Detected share code {{shareCode}}. Fetching the file for you...
help.intro: 📚 How to use VaultLink Bot 1. Tap /new or "📤 Create share" 2. Send a single file, or a Collection of multiple files 3. For a Collection, tap "✅ Finish" when done 4. Send the code or tap the link to retrieve files
help.commands: General commands /start — get started /help — show this help /my_files — list your files /del <code> — delete one of your files /set_password <code> <password> — protect a file /remove_password <code> — remove a file password /report <code> — report a file /lang — change language
help.bot_management: Personal bot management /add_bot <BOT_TOKEN> — add a private bot (only you can use it) /add_bot_open <BOT_TOKEN> — add a public bot (anyone can use it) /my_bots — list your bots /remove_bot <@username> — remove one of your bots /allow <user_id> — allow a user (private mode) /deny <user_id> — revoke a user /allow_upload <user_id> — let a user upload through your bot /deny_upload <user_id> — block a user from uploading
terms.body: 📄 VaultLink Bot Terms of Service 1. The service is provided as-is, without any availability guarantee. 2. Do not use the service to share content that is illegal in your jurisdiction, infringes on copyright, or harms others. 3. Administrators reserve the right to delete files, suspend accounts, or lock share codes that are reported or found to violate these terms. 4. You retain ownership of the files you upload and may delete them at any time. 5. Continued use of the service means you accept these terms.
privacy.body: 🔐 Privacy Policy • We store only what is necessary: Telegram IDs, language preference, uploaded file metadata, and usage statistics. • Personal bot tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. • File passwords are hashed with argon2id and cannot be recovered. • We do not inspect your file contents and do not share data with third parties. • You can delete your own files at any time via /my_files or /del.
